LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodTooltip: Left to right: stronger compression for extreme high values.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Formula_Logarithmic: Logarithmic: f(x) = h + ln(1 + ln(t)(x - h)) / ln(t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_Formula_SoftCap: Soft cap: f(x) = h + t(x - h) / ((x - h) + t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_ParameterTooltip: Linear: 0 <= t <= 1, default 0.1 Power: 0 < t < 1, default 0.5 Logarithmic: t > 1, default 2 Soft cap: t > 1, default 10
LanguageData.StatCompression_CompressAboveTooltip: Higher-is-better stats are compressed when they exceed this relative baseline. Default: 100%. Lower-is-better stats are compressed when they fall below the inverse threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ImportedMessage: Imported settings XML: updated={0}, skipped={1}, path={2}
LanguageData.StatCompression_BenchmarkOnGameLoad: Run a 10,000-call backend benchmark after loading a map
LanguageData.StatCompression_BenchmarkTooltip: After a map loads, use the first spawned free colonist and randomly select an enabled visible stat. Each backend is warmed up, then measured for 10,000 direct compression calls and 10,000 complete StatWorker calls. Results are written to Player.log.
LanguageData.StatCompression_BenchmarkCompleted: Stat Compression benchmark completed for {0}. See Player.log for results.
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedHelp: Configure compression for each stat. Method selects the mapping function. Let x = stat value / baseline and h = Threshold. If x is below h, f(x)=x; above h, only the excess x-h is compressed.
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedFormulaHelp: Linear: h+(x-h)t; Power: h+((x-h)+1)^t-1; Logarithmic: h+ln(1+ln(t)(x-h))/ln(t); Soft cap: h+t(x-h)/((x-h)+t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionHelp: Direction: Higher compresses values above the threshold; Lower compresses values below the inverse threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionTooltip: Higher: compress values above the threshold. Lower: compress values below the inverse threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_TScaleTooltip: t scale adjusts this stat's compression strength. Larger means stronger compression. The final method parameter is derived from global t and this scale.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Power: Power compression is equivalent to reducing multiplicative gains proportionally.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Logarit: Logarithmic compression is equivalent to converting multiplicative gains into additive growth.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_SoftCap: Soft cap compression keeps the compressed value below a fixed upper limit.
